target.title: refactor(cli-runner): remove dead claude-live drain-aborted-turn state
target.body:
## Summary

- Removes the dead `drainTimer` / `drainingAbortedTurn` state from `ClaudeLiveSession`.
- No behavior change: the "drain aborted turn" machinery was never actually activated, so this only deletes unreachable code and misleading state.

## Motivation

Addresses item 2 of #98946 ("Dead 'drain aborted turn' machinery").

The `drainTimer` and `drainingAbortedTurn` fields on `ClaudeLiveSession` are **read** in four places (`closeLiveSession`, `handleClaudeLiveLine`, `handleClaudeExit`, `closeOldestIdleSession`, `runClaudeLiveSessionTurn`) but are **never** set to a truthy / non-null value anywhere in the file — they are only ever initialized to and reset to `false` / `null`. As a result:

- The `if (session.drainingAbortedTurn) { ... }` branch in `handleClaudeLiveLine` is unreachable.
- `clearDrainTimer()` never has anything to clear.
- The `&& !session.drainingAbortedTurn` / `|| session.drainingAbortedTurn` guard clauses always evaluate the `currentTurn` side alone.

This has been dead since the state was introduced, leaving ~30 lines of misleading code that implies a drain lifecycle that does not exist.

## Changes

- Remove `drainTimer` and `drainingAbortedTurn` from the `ClaudeLiveSession` type and its initializer.
- Remove the `clearDrainTimer` helper and its (no-op) call sites in `closeLiveSession` and `handleClaudeExit`.
- Remove the unreachable draining branch in `handleClaudeLiveLine`.
- Simplify the two guard conditions in `closeOldestIdleSession` and `runClaudeLiveSessionTurn`.

Net: `+2 / -28`, one file.

## Verification

- `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.core.json` — no errors in `claude-live-session.ts`.
- `npx vitest run src/agents/cli-runner.reliability.test.ts` — 130 passed (2 files).
- Grep confirms zero remaining references to `drainTimer` / `drainingAbortedTurn` / `clearDrainTimer`.
- Did NOT touch the other items in #98946 (loopback failure, exit-0 failover, >5MB reseed, image cleanup, prepare temp leaks) — those are separate fixes and out of scope for this focused change.
